response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(sp.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref WHERE sp.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_of_site_ram_averages, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_of_site_ratio_averages FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: “Pass a 60.8 GB threshold” means RAM usage is strictly greater than 60.8 GB; records equal to the threshold are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: If passing the threshold means RAM usage is at least 60.8 GB, include records equal to the threshold.
